note: Jev-class decision models released after the pinned JevBench roster. engines.name: Liquid d1-ultra (Liquid AI Console, hosted System One)

status.status: released 2026-10-15; not yet measured by JevBench

engines.notes: Liquid's strongest decision model: multimodal, 44 languages, #1 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index at release. Speaks the System One schema natively at Liquid's own endpoint ($0.042 per million input tokens, no output tokens; each question is billed for the state and every image again). Keys come from console.liquid.ai (liquid_...). Store one with `nur jev login liquid-d1-ultra` or export LIQUID_AI_API_KEY; the liquid-d1-ultra, liquid-d1-direct and liquid-d1-free engines share that one slot. nur reads LIQUID_AI_API_KEY rather than the LIQUID_API_KEY Liquid's docs name, because LIQUID_API_KEY already belongs to the Liquid Inference chat route.
